standard_prerequisites.name: Fundamental identity (Proposition 3.1)
standard_prerequisites.statement: For polynomial W with positive integer exponents the W-scalar product equals a contour integral of P(z)W(z) against a ray integral of W*(u)Q*(u) e^{-uz} (eq:PQscalar, delivered in context).
standard_prerequisites.use: Load-bearing: step (a)-(b) takes Q(z) = z^k in this identity and reads off eq:Pzk.

standard_prerequisites.name: Scalar product and orthogonality system of P_n
standard_prerequisites.statement: The scalar product of the modified Gaussian measure and the defining vanishing-moment system of P_n (eq:fgscalar, def:Pn, delivered in context).
standard_prerequisites.use: Load-bearing: the equivalence is stated for the monic polynomial P_n of this system; the alternative proof cites def:Pn directly.

standard_prerequisites.name: Operator properties W1, W2, W3
standard_prerequisites.statement: Stated inside the main proof span (source lines 448-475): kernel description eq:Wproperty1, degree behaviour eq:Wproperty2/eq:Wproperty2alt, vanishing-order reduction eq:Wproperty3.
standard_prerequisites.use: Load-bearing: the (c)-(d) equivalences apply them explicitly; the source states them as basic properties of the product-form operator and proves none of them.

standard_prerequisites.name: Uniqueness theorem for constant-coefficient linear ODEs
standard_prerequisites.statement: A solution of a homogeneous constant-coefficient linear ODE of order c with c vanishing initial conditions is identically zero.
standard_prerequisites.use: Load-bearing: step (c)-(d) concludes Q = 0 from the c vanishing initial conditions (source lines 513-514); standard named theorem, stated without proof in the source.

core_obligations: (a)-(b): take Q(z) = z^k in the fundamental identity (eq:PQscalar) to obtain eq:Pzk, which restates (a) as (b).

(b)-(c): a Laplace-transform identity, integration by parts on the closed contour, and coefficient comparison convert (b) into vanishing of the first n Taylor coefficients of W*(D_z)[P_n W] (eq:Taylorzero2).
(d)-(c): apply W*(D_z) to eq:Pnequiv4 and use W1 and W3.
(c)-(d): injectivity of the coefficient map pi on ker W*(D_z) via W1-W3 and the ODE uniqueness theorem, surjectivity by dimension, then coefficient matching to build the Q_j of eq:Pnequiv4.
proof_roadmap: Four-implication equivalence proof: (a)-(b) is the fundamental identity with Q = z^k; (b)-(c) is a Laplace-transform and integration-by-parts computation; (c)-(d) and (d)-(c) run an injectivity-surjectivity argument on the kernel of the differential operator using the stated properties W1-W3.
An alternative Fourier-transform proof of (a) implies (c) (source lines 554-604) is appended as a second proof span.
difficulty_reason: H2整链：215-244、281-397、413-604将二维Gaussian-planar orthogonality转为一维contour-Laplace moment，再转constant-coefficient differential operator的Taylor消失条件，并构造kernel exponential-polynomial的稀疏Taylor projection以证明type-I interpolation存在且唯一；还保留作者Wirtinger/Fourier替代证明。研究难点为planar权与type-I multiple orthogonality的等价及kernel projection，而非单独Cauchy/Fubini技巧。
